utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so—just tell me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard that folks are still gathering donations and sorting the repair priorities, so a quick list would really help. I can pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — a quick list would help a lot. I’ll send the donation needs and repair priorities in a simple, task-focused note.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what’s the easiest way for me to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — if you could just quietly help connect people and keep it flexible around schedules, that’d be a big help. I’m trying to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive. What time were you thinking this weekend so I can work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d keep it to Saturday morning if that works — folks are still lining up donations and the main fixes, so that gives everyone time to get ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Cleo, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I can check what we’ve got left and make a quick needs list. Just tell me what’s most needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s still happening—keeping it simple and on track. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep track of the locations once you send them. That’ll help keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I can check what’s left and make a quick list. Just tell me the most needed items.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: After school would be best, once pickup eases up and parking opens a bit. I’m trying to keep the logistics simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: After school works for me too—let’s pick a clear time and keep the plan simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s set a clear time for the repair drive and keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—let’s make it Saturday morning at 10, and I’ll start spreading the word right away. If anyone wants to help, I’ll line them up with a simple task.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late again, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Glad you made it, Dane — Oren’s still coordinating, and we could use help with outreach or setup. What would you like to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey—let’s keep spreading the Sunday at the community center update first. After that, we can check who still needs a task for setup and signs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll share the Sunday community center update first, then check who still needs setup or sign tasks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep it simple and send the details when I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira—just send the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll round up whatever tools we need.
